overview: The Council approved a special permit for extended restaurant hours and appropriated $120,000 from Community Preservation Act funds for fire station roof repairs.

items.title: Public Hearing: Mushari and Grill Special Permit
items.summary: Approved a special permit for Mushari and Grill at 321A Boston Avenue to extend its operating hours until 2:00 a.m. throughout the week.

items.title: CPA Appropriation for Fire Station Engine Roof 4
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $120,000 from the Community Preservation Act General Reserve for the restoration of the roof at Fire Station Engine 4.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: Accepted committee reports regarding tax classification and recent council site visits to local streets.

items.title: Public Participation and Meeting Records
items.summary: Tabled the approval of prior meeting records because copies had not been distributed to council members.
